description: This bar chart, titled “Per-specialty terms,” displays the negative log probability for various medical specialties, with the horizontal axis labeled “Per-specialty terms” listing six categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and ranges from -22 to -27 on a linear scale, indicating that lower values represent higher probabilities. The chart includes a legend indicating that the light blue bars represent “Mistralv0.2-Base,” while the other bars are color-coded by specialty: light peach for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. Each specialty category has one light blue bar and five colored bars stacked vertically, suggesting a comparison of the model’s probability distribution across terms within each specialty. The bars are arranged in descending order of height (i.e., ascending negative log probability) from left to right, with Cardio showing the highest probability (least negative log probability) and Pediatrics showing the lowest probability (most negative log probability). The light blue “Mistralv0.2-Base” bars are consistently the shortest, indicating the highest negative log probability values, while the other specialty bars are longer, indicating lower negative log probability values. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their color coding and height differences.
